Dioskouroi The Dioskouroi is the term for Kastor and his brother Polydeukes Dryas of Kalydon Dryas was a native to Kalydon. Like Meleagros he was a son of Ares. Dryas took part in the hunt. While Dryas did survive the hunt, he did not do something to make him stand out. Hippasus Hippasus of Eurytas was one of the heroes who went on the Kalydonian Boar Hunt. The Roman epic poet Ovid and the historian Hygineus give the most description of him in the hunt. Unfortunately Hippasus was fated to die…

Kastor may refer to:

Castor and Pollux, twin brothers in Greek and Roman mythology

Kastor und Pollux, a complex of two towers in Frankfurt, Germany, named after the mythological characters

Kastor of Rhodes, a Greek grammarian and rhetorician

Kastor, an unrelated character in the 2002 video game Age of Mythology

Kastor is also the surname of:

Adolph Kastor, a founder of Camillus Cutlery Company

Deena Kastor (born 1973), an American long-distance runner
